paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Taddai, Shabbat 123a. A tanna of a baraita, Haddar 71b: Rav Beruna in Rav’s name says the law follows him; Tosefta, Eruvin, chapter 5; Mekhilta Beshalach; Tanchuma Beshalach; Jerusalem Talmud, Kirah, halakhah 3. Yuchasin’s Sherira Gaon epistle places him in Shimon ben Gamliel, Pinchas ben Yair, Yishmael son of Yochanan ben Beroka, and Yehoshua ben Korcha’s generation. See Taddai.
